summary: B412：合并视图按各流当前版本看板配置归列——columns 新增 mergeIntoDefaultColumns/mergedLayoutFor/asLayoutResolver 与 WorkflowBoardLookup/CardLayoutResolver 类型，cardsInColumn/visibleColumns 签名扩为 BoardLayout | CardLayoutResolver

n_web_app_cards_mergeIntoDefaultColumns.name: mergeIntoDefaultColumns
n_web_app_cards_mergeIntoDefaultColumns.summary: 把某条流的布局收敛到固定默认五列（合并视图，spec D2/D3）：列集合恒为 DEFAULT_BOARD_COLUMNS，映射目标不在默认五列的状态与未映射状态都落「进行中」；只在「全部工作流」合并视图用，单流视图不调本函数。

n_web_app_cards_mergedLayoutFor.name: mergedLayoutFor
n_web_app_cards_mergedLayoutFor.summary: 合并视图下单张卡的呈现布局（spec D1/D3）：该流布局收敛到默认五列；流未知（flows 未加载完/已删改名）时退回默认映射，与现状同形的诚实兜底，不新增请求。

n_web_app_cards_asLayoutResolver.name: asLayoutResolver
n_web_app_cards_asLayoutResolver.summary: 兼容两种 layout 入参形态：既有调用点传 BoardLayout（或 undefined）零改动，合并视图传 CardLayoutResolver 逐卡解析；BoardLayout 是对象、resolver 是函数，用 typeof 区分。

m_web_app_cards_WorkflowBoardLookup.name: WorkflowBoardLookup
m_web_app_cards_WorkflowBoardLookup.signature: export type WorkflowBoardLookup = (workflow: string) => BoardLayout | undefined
m_web_app_cards_WorkflowBoardLookup.summary: 按工作流名取该流**当前版本**的看板布局；未知流返回 undefined。

m_web_app_cards_CardLayoutResolver.name: CardLayoutResolver
m_web_app_cards_CardLayoutResolver.summary: 给一张卡解析它的呈现布局：合并视图逐卡按流解析，单流视图所有卡共用一份。

n_web_app_cards_cardsInColumn.name: cardsInColumn
n_web_app_cards_cardsInColumn.signature: export function cardsInColumn(cards: CardView[], column: string, layout?: BoardLayout | CardLayoutResolver): CardView[]
n_web_app_cards_cardsInColumn.signatureOld: export function cardsInColumn(cards: CardView[], column: string, layout?: BoardLayout): CardView[]

n_web_app_cards_visibleColumns.name: visibleColumns
n_web_app_cards_visibleColumns.signature: export function visibleColumns(columns: string[], cards: CardView[], collapseEmpty: boolean, layout?: BoardLayout | CardLayoutResolver): string[]
